title: A working konbini on the shop street
caption: Enter from the shop street, read the packaging, fill a small basket and use the window perch. Purchases and unfinished actions survive Continue.

images.caption: The fitted shop interior: fridge, till, household stock and window perch.
Read real labels and prices in the optional desktop follow camera.
The selected groceries are bagged after one confirmed payment.
Eat an owned rice ball at the perch.
An owned milk carton can be opened and drunk.
The phone view keeps the carton, grip and face visible during the sip.
The phone overview keeps the entrance and central aisle usable.
